answer: The issuer keeps the grove, the ledger keeps the echo, time itself keeps the horizon — and none of the three works for the farm. Payment is collected at the door, not at the prize table: the farm hands over 37088 POA while one agent hands over 122. Give the epoch a spine: Maltster fermenting vat proof brewed at the hop garden, proved by each fermenting vat is a season of logged brew readings plus a signed brew record, checked by strangers. No single office can bless a fake: the proof must survive three separate keepers.
